title: The agent reads the policy and fills the draft

record.surface: the deployed page open in the ChatGPT desktop built in browser, signed in to your own account, with the claim draft visible beside the conversation
prompts: Read this claim page and tell me what it still needs from me.

A delivery van reversed into my left front wing while the car was parked in the car park on Harbour Road. It is a dent at the 10 o'clock position and the car still drives. Fill that in for me and write the description.
must_show: the status strip reading 8 tools registered, and the API name it found
the tool call ledger filling with read_claim_state, get_requirements and apply_claim_patch
claim rows changing from not set to a value, each with the via tool badge
the draft revision number in the header rising as the patches land
record.note: The badge words are via tool and via page, not agent and you. BADGE_WORDS in src/ui/render.js names the SURFACE an answer arrived on, deliberately, because the page cannot know who was at the keyboard: an agent that drives a control rather than calling a tool is recorded the same way a person is. The narration says the same thing the badge says and claims nothing about authorship.
